module load openmpi/5.0.10-nvhpc26.3-pgi-cuda12-auto fftw/3.3.10 hdf5/1.14.6-pgi-ompi508
#vim install/configure

#    lxc_version_minor=`grep "XC_MINOR_VERSION" "$with_libxc_include/xc_version.h" | tr -dc '0-9'`

make pwall -j
make install
